messages:
sam: Hey @ops-bot alerted us to p95 latency spike + 401s for tenant 'acme-inc'. Request id in logs: req=0x9f1a23. Need repro bundle from dedicated-eu cluster. Who can grab pod logs + node metrics?
ops-bot: Alert: 2024-11-12T14:33:12Z - tenant acme-inc - 401 auth.invalid_token - request_id=0x9f1a23 - region=eu-west1
priya: I can take this. Which pods? Which time range?
sam: Thanks. Spike started ~14:32 UTC. Affected pods: inference-queue-0, transformer-svc-1, cache-proxy-2 on dedicated-eu-24. Also saw node heartbeat drop on node g4-34. Repro curl included below.
mike: Leave it with me for logs + nvidia capture.
sam: curl repro (use customer token): 
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Request-Id: 0x9f1a23" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"test latency"}'
```
priya: I'll run kubectl -n tenant-acme logs -l app=inference --since=15m and collect for pod names. Also will grab docker/containerd logs.
mike: nvidia-smi sampling and dmesg: 
```
watch -n 0.5 nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,utilization.gpu,temperature.gpu,fb_memory.used --format=csv
sudo dmesg | tail -n 200
```
priya: Also attaching kube describe and pod yaml:
```bash
kubectl -n tenant-acme get pods -o wide
kubectl -n tenant-acme describe pod inference-queue-0
kubectl -n tenant-acme get events --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -n 200
```
sam: We need request traces from the runtime too: /var/log/redwood/runtime/request.log and kv cache metrics.
ingest-bot: saved trace: /var/backups/traces/2024-11-12/0x9f1a23.trace.gz
mike: Found kernel oops in dmesg at 14:31:58 on g4-34: "GPU hang: blocked for 3000ms, XID 79" — saving full dmesg snippet.
priya: Collected pod logs (zipped) and metrics snapshots. Uploading to S3: s3://redwood-debug/acme/2045236789/
devex: Heads up: customer token cycles every 24h; if they were mid-rotation might explain 401s. Can we check auth-service logs around 14:32?
sam: Good point. Priya, can you fetch auth-svc logs for 14:30-14:35 with request id?
priya: grabbing now:
```
kubectl -n auth logs -l app=auth-service --since=10m | grep 0x9f1a23 -C3
```
priya: Auth logs show token validation failed: "jwt: key not found" at 14:32:05 for req 0x9f1a23 — looks like rotation hit. But GPU hang may have caused backlog leading to retries and token expiry.
mike: Uploaded GPU stats and nvidia-smi csv to S3 path above. Also ps aux and container restart counts.
sam: Next steps: assemble debug bundle (node snap, pod logs, runtime trace, auth logs, kernel logs). Priya, Mike — can you both confirm you uploaded?
priya: Uploaded pod-logs.tar.gz and auth-logs.gz
mike: Uploaded node-dmesg.log and nvidia-stats.csv
sam: I'll create support ticket and attach S3 link. Also suggest enabling temporary fallback model (cpu fallback) to keep customer running while we investigate.
priya: For repro: we can replay the curl with X-Request-Id header from within cluster to hit same routing:
```bash
kubectl -n tenant-acme run debug-curl --image=curlimages/curl --restart=Never --rm -it -- \
  sh -c "curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -H 'X-Request-Id: 0x9f1a23' -X POST https://localhost:8080/v1/generate -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-v1\",\"input\":\"test latency\"}'"
```
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2024-4692 assigned to sam/priya. SLA: 4h for dedicated clusters.
sam: tagging @mike because kernel XID suggests possible GPU driver bug; please open driver ticket with cloud provider if we see more XID 79.
mike: Will do if we see repeats. For now we should correlate heartbeat drops with auth rotations.
priya: One more note: tenant had high prefix cache miss rate at time — runtime metrics show cache-miss spike. Possibly long tail of requests queued due to GPU hang leading to auth timeouts.
sam: ok. I'll mark thread as "collecting bundles" — will update when S3 attachments confirmed and ticket created.
priya: S3 manifest: 
- s3://redwood-debug/acme/2045236789/pod-logs.tar.gz
- s3://redwood-debug/acme/2045236789/node-dmesg.log
- s3://redwood-debug/acme/2045236789/nvidia-stats.csv
- s3://redwood-debug/acme/2045236789/auth-logs.gz
- s3://redwood-debug/acme/2045236789/trace-0x9f1a23.trace.gz
sam: last ask: please include output of `kubectl get csinodes` and `kubectl get nodes -o json` — we might need node labels/taints.
mike: Added node json and csinode output to S3.
sam: thanks team :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-4692 updated: status=investigating, severity=high.
priya: closing loop — we've handed over bundle to eng-runtime for root-cause analysis: eng-runtime ticket ER-1129 with link to S3.
sam: noted. Will follow ER-1129. End.
